title: The Storage Room Murder
motive_summary: Marcus Bell was being blackmailed by Elias Grant over a secret ledger.
overview_text: 10:14 — Elias Grant found dead in Priya's Flat by Owen Price. Several villagers passed nearby around that time; no one claims to have seen what happened. The morning can be rewound from 08:02.
